verdict.rationale: Stable has a documented public API. It authenticates with an x-api-key header and has reference pages for companies, locations, onboarding sessions and signature packets, plus mail-item search and retrieval. However, the docs say the API currently covers only searching and retrieving MailItems and creating and onboarding Locations, so core mailbox actions are not shown as drivable by API, and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: API coverage of mail actions (scan/ship/shred/deposit), a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Currently the API supports searching for and retrieving **MailItems**, as well as creating new **Locations** and onboarding them via the USPS Form 1583.
Authentication to the Stable API is performed via the x-api-key header.
Returns a list of locations associated with your account.
You can create and manage your own API keys directly in the dashboard under Settings > API keys
